articles.title: Red Bull's Hadjar to miss Spanish GP as injury absence continues
articles.summary: Isack Hadjar will miss this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid as he continues to recover from a fractured wrist.

articles.title: Red Roses name experienced squad for home leg of WXV Global Series
articles.summary: Red Roses head coach John Mitchell has named an experienced 36-player squad for the home leg of the WXV Global Series, with 25 World Cup winners included.
